info.title: ajs-accountd Admin API
info.summary: Loopback admin contract for the ajs-accountd control plane.
info.description:
OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the ajs-accountd HTTP surface. Every route registered in daemon/internal/api/server.go is documented, together with the proposed next-phase interfaces. All routes are loopback-only. Requests carry Authorization: Bearer $AJS_ADMIN_TOKEN or an ajs_sk_ scoped key except GET /healthz; AJS_ALLOW_INSECURE=1 disables the check on a loopback bind. Responses never contain credentials. Errors share the {"error":{"code","message","reason?","details?"}} envelope.

Every operation carries x-implementation-phase: P0 operations are served by the current daemon; P1 operations are the proposed next-phase contract (account IO, catalog selection/connect, schedules) and may not be registered in a given build. See docs/PANEL.md for the design and docs/openapi.json as the source of truth.

The customer portal is a separate chain. With AJS_TENANT_PORTAL=1, /v1/portal/* authenticates only the opaque __Host-ajs_portal cookie plus X-CSRF-Token; an admin token or scoped key cannot act as a tenant, and a portal cookie grants no dashboard route. /v1/admin/tenants* requires the admin token or a scoped key carrying the admin scope, even when AJS_ALLOW_INSECURE=1. The portal routes are not registered while the flag is off and answer 404.

Every unsafe admin operation (POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE outside the customer portal and the payment provider callbacks) also requires the X-AJS-CSRF: 1 header; when an Origin header is present it must exactly match AJS_ADMIN_ORIGINS. Requests without Origin (CLI/SDK clients) must send the header too.

get.summary: Replay the retained event ring from a cursor.
get.description: Returns up to limit retained events published after since, oldest first. An empty since starts at the oldest retained event. When the cursor is current and wait is set, the request is held until the next event arrives or the wait budget expires, then answers a page (possibly empty) whose nextCursor is the resume point. A malformed cursor is 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT; a cursor whose event was evicted is 410 CURSOR_EXPIRED and details.oldestCursor names the restart point. A scoped key restricted by accountIds/regions is refused 403 because the ring is global.

200.description: One page of retained events and the cursor to pass next.

get.summary: Stream retained and live events as server-sent events.
get.description: text/event-stream. The cursor comes from Last-Event-ID (sent by a browser on reconnect) or since; the header wins. Every event is one id:/event:/data: frame whose data is the Event JSON object. Retained events after the cursor are replayed first, then live events follow; a duplicate that appears in both windows is sent once. A ': keepalive' comment every 15 s keeps proxies from closing an idle stream. A malformed cursor is 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT; an evicted one is 410 CURSOR_EXPIRED with details.oldestCursor, both as JSON before the stream starts. The stream closes when the client disconnects or the daemon shuts down.

200.description: SSE frames; the response never ends on its own while the daemon runs.

get.summary: Read the bounded, redacted runtime trace ring.
get.description: Returns up to limit retained trace entries, oldest first, optionally filtered by account. The ring is in-memory and capped at 500 entries: it survives no restart, and a restarted daemon starts at sequence 1 with an empty window. Each entry carries a monotonic sequence, account/node/server attribution, the slot and generation, and the timing of one runtime boundary (switch steps, gate open/close, session open/lose, lease create/revoke, slot state). Secrets are redacted before storage; there is no field for a SID, cookie, token or device identity. A scoped key needs catalog:read; a key restricted by accountIds/regions sees only its accounts and an ?account= outside the grant is 403.

200.description: One bounded window of redacted trace entries and the cursor to resume from.

get.summary: Stream retained and live trace entries as server-sent events.
get.description: text/event-stream. The cursor comes from Last-Event-ID (sent by a browser on reconnect) or since; the header wins. Every frame is one id:/event:/data: frame whose id is the sequence and whose data is the DebugTrace JSON object. Retained entries after the cursor are replayed first, then live entries follow; a duplicate that appears in both windows is sent once. A stale cursor (evicted, or from a previous process) restarts from the oldest retained entry and sets X-Debug-Restarted: true instead of failing. A ': keepalive' comment every 15 s keeps proxies from closing an idle stream. The stream closes when the client disconnects or the daemon shuts down.

200.description: SSE frames; the response never ends on its own while the daemon runs.

X-Debug-Restarted.description: true when the requested cursor was stale and the stream restarted from the oldest retained entry.

post.summary: Seal the panel state files into an encrypted envelope download.
post.description: Admin only: no scoped key can reach this route. Reads state.json (AJS_STATE_FILE when set, otherwise AJS_STATE_DIR), secrets.json and device-secrets.json and returns the envelope as application/octet-stream. The body holds ciphertext only; no path, blob or passphrase is logged. Answers 409 BACKUP_BUSY while another backup or restore runs, 409 CONFLICT when no state.json snapshot exists yet, and 400 for a passphrase outside 12-1024 bytes.

X-AJS-Backup-Blobs.description: Number of blobs sealed into the envelope.

post.summary: Read a backup header, and its manifest when the passphrase is supplied.
post.description: Admin only. Parses the envelope without decrypting it, so no passphrase is required: the response carries version, supported, app, createdAt and envelopeBytes. The manifest lives inside the encrypted payload, so it is returned only when a passphrase is supplied; names, sizes and SHA-256 digests are reported and no blob content is ever returned. A document whose app is not "apc" answers 400.

200.description: Envelope header, plus the manifest when a passphrase was supplied.

post.summary: Compare a backup with the live panel, then optionally replace the state files.
post.description: Admin only. dryRun defaults to true and writes nothing, returning the diff only. dryRun:false additionally needs confirm:"RESTORE" and a correct passphrase. An apply is refused with 409 BACKUP_LIVE_NODE while any proxy node is LIVE, and with 409 BACKUP_DAEMON_RUNNING unless AJS_BACKUP_ALLOW_RESTORE=1, because the running daemon cannot serve the restored panel. Files are replaced atomically (0600 temporary file plus rename) and a file the backup omits is never deleted. A successful apply answers restartRequired:true and exitRecommended:true: the process marks itself restored, refuses every later state.json snapshot (the interval ticker, a bulk persist and the shutdown save; logged once as state_save_suppressed_after_restore) and should be stopped, so the restored file survives a graceful SIGTERM.

200.description: Diff report; applied, files, restartRequired and exitRecommended after an apply.

parameters.name: Stripe-Signature
parameters.description: t=<unix>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256 hex>. Verified over the exact raw body with a timestamp tolerance; a bearer token is never accepted here.

get.summary: Verify a 易支付 GET query callback and record its settlement event.
get.description: No bearer token: the MD5 signature over the query string is the credential. This is the standard 易支付 notify transport. Verifies sign, pid, trade_status=TRADE_SUCCESS and money against the immutable order snapshot, then applies the event idempotently by trade_no. Answers success only for an accepted or duplicate event, fail otherwise. Disabled configuration answers 503.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: Merchant id; must match AJS_EPAY_PID.

parameters.name: trade_no
parameters.description: Gateway transaction id; the idempotency key of the settlement event.

parameters.name: out_trade_no
parameters.description: The order id issued at checkout.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Gateway payment channel.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Plan name echoed by the gateway.

parameters.name: money
parameters.description: Decimal amount with two places; must equal the immutable order snapshot.

parameters.name: trade_status
parameters.description: Only a completed trade settles.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Lowercase hex MD5 of the canonical sorted parameters plus the merchant key.

parameters.name: sign_type
parameters.description: Signature algorithm; only MD5 is supported.

200.description: Plain-text acknowledgement: success for an accepted or duplicate event, fail for every rejection.

post.summary: Verify a 易支付 notify (GET query or POST form) and record its settlement event.
post.description: No bearer token: the MD5 signature over the query string/form body is the credential. Verifies sign, pid, trade_status=TRADE_SUCCESS and money against the immutable order snapshot, then applies the event idempotently by trade_no. Standard 易支付 sends GET query parameters; a POST form body is also accepted. Answers the plain-text protocol: success only for an accepted or duplicate event, fail otherwise. Disabled configuration answers 503.

trade_no.description: Gateway transaction id; the idempotency key of the settlement event.

out_trade_no.description: The order id issued at checkout.

name.description: Plan name echoed by the gateway.

money.description: Decimal amount with two places; must equal the immutable order snapshot.

sign.description: Lowercase hex MD5 of the canonical sorted parameters plus the merchant key.

200.description: Plain-text acknowledgement: success for an accepted or duplicate event, fail for every rejection.

bearerAuth.description: AJS_ADMIN_TOKEN as an Authorization: Bearer token, or an ajs_sk_ scoped key issued by POST /v1/scoped-keys. Only /healthz and /readyz are unauthenticated. AJS_ALLOW_INSECURE=1 disables the check on loopback. Every unsafe admin request also requires X-AJS-CSRF: 1, and an Origin header must exactly match AJS_ADMIN_ORIGINS. The production admin vhost adds per-operator HTTP Basic auth and forwards the authenticated username as X-AJS-Operator; the daemon uses it only as the audit actor on admin mutations (falling back to operator when absent), never as an authentication factor.

portalCookie.name: __Host-ajs_portal
portalCookie.description: Opaque tenant session set only by POST /v1/portal/login as HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Path=/ with an eight-hour absolute and thirty-minute idle expiry. JavaScript cannot read it. Every unsafe portal request must also send the per-session X-CSRF-Token returned by login and GET /v1/portal/session. The portal chain is registered only when AJS_TENANT_PORTAL=1.

BadRequest.description: INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed query, body or field value.

Unauthorized.description: UNAUTHORIZED: missing or invalid bearer token, or a missing, expired, revoked or unlinked portal session.

Forbidden.description: FORBIDDEN: the scoped key lacks the route scope, the account is outside its accountIds/regions, a portal request failed its origin, CSRF or tenant-status check, or an admin request failed the X-AJS-CSRF header or exact Origin allowlist check.

NotFound.description: NOT_FOUND: the addressed resource does not exist.

Conflict.description: CONFLICT: the request is valid but the current state refuses it (duplicate label, disabled mode, snapshot change, connect cooldown, busy account IO).

PayloadTooLarge.description: INVALID_ARGUMENT: request body exceeds the route limit (1 MiB, 64 KiB for portal routes, 4 MiB for account import, 16 MiB for device-pool import, 97 MiB for backup inspect/restore).

RateLimited.description: RATE_LIMITED or QUOTA_EXCEEDED: retry later. A lease create carries reason account_slots_exhausted when the account already holds its one admission slot (lease admission is hard-capped at one until the multi-slot runtime exists; display capacity may be higher).

InternalError.description: INTERNAL: unexpected server failure; details stay in the daemon log.

BadGateway.description: UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: the gate or vendor session could not be opened.

ServiceUnavailable.description: UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: a required dependency (Resin, login service, sealed secret store) is unavailable.

CursorExpired.description: CURSOR_EXPIRED: the cursor names an event that is no longer retained. details.oldestCursor is the oldest retained id, the point to restart from.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size. 0 means no limit; the daemon clamps it to the remaining rows.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Rows to skip before the page.

UserIdFilter.name: user_id
UserIdFilter.description: Filter by user id. userId is accepted as an alias.

EventSince.name: since
EventSince.description: Cursor to replay after: the id of the last event the client saw. Empty starts at the oldest retained event.

EventLimit.name: limit
EventLimit.description: Page size; a larger value is clamped to 500.

EventWait.name: wait
EventWait.description: Long-poll budget as a Go duration (for example 25s), capped at 25s. Applied only when since is current; the request answers as soon as an event arrives.

DeliveryLimit.name: limit
DeliveryLimit.description: Page size over the newest-first merged history; a larger value is clamped to 500.

EventLastEventID.name: Last-Event-ID
EventLastEventID.description: Cursor sent by an SSE client on reconnect; wins over since.

DebugAccount.name: account
DebugAccount.description: Only entries attributed to this account id. A scoped key restricted to other accounts is refused 403.

DebugLimit.name: limit
DebugLimit.description: Newest window size; 0 returns every retained entry and a larger value is clamped to 500.

DebugSince.name: since
DebugSince.description: Resume after this sequence, as a bare number (42) or an SSE id (evt-000042). A stale cursor restarts from the oldest retained entry and sets X-Debug-Restarted: true.

AccountIdFilter.name: account_id
AccountIdFilter.description: Filter by account id. accountId is accepted as an alias.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Retry-safe create key. A replay returns the original lease with replayed=true instead of allocating a second node.

PortalCSRF.name: X-CSRF-Token
PortalCSRF.description: Per-session CSRF token returned by login and GET /v1/portal/session. Required on every unsafe portal request, including logout and key revocation; compared by SHA-256 in constant time.

OrderIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
OrderIdempotencyKey.description: Retry-safe order-create key. The same key and plan replays the original order (200); the same key with a different plan answers 409.

AdminCSRF.name: X-AJS-CSRF
AdminCSRF.description: Non-simple CSRF header required on every unsafe admin request. A cross-origin HTML form cannot set it; a cross-origin fetch must pass a CORS preflight that only an allowlisted admin origin receives. Requests without an Origin header (CLI/SDK clients) must also send it.

NodeState.description: LIVE and DRAINING claim a running gate. STALE means the row survived a restart with no gate: gatePort is 0, egressIp is empty and its lease is closed until a login sync reopens it.

RequestSource.description: proxy = seeded/imported panel traffic, mutation-lab = the request lab, gate = a real accepted flow metered by the node controller.

id.description: Monotonic cursor such as evt-000123; pass it back as since or Last-Event-ID.

type.description: Wire event name, one of the WebhookEvent values.

data.description: Event payload, scrubbed of credential-shaped keys before it reaches the ring.

events.description: Retained events after the cursor, oldest first. Never null.

nextCursor.description: Id of the last returned event; unchanged when the page is empty.

oldestCursor.description: Oldest retained id, the restart point after CURSOR_EXPIRED; empty when the ring is empty.

dropped.description: Lifetime count of subscriber deliveries skipped because that subscriber could not keep up.

seq.description: Monotonic ring sequence. Stable for the life of the process and not durable: a restart starts at 1.

kind.description: Runtime boundary that emitted the entry.

accountId.description: Account the event is attributed to; empty for an unattributed event.

nodeId.description: Node the event is attributed to.

slot.description: One-based account slot; omitted when the event predates multi-slot.

generation.description: Session generation of the slot; an event from an older generation is stale.

step.description: Stable switch step name (validate, drain, start_gate, commit) or the trigger of a terminal switch entry. The session open step is its own session.open entry.

state.description: Outcome of the boundary: ok, failed, open, closed, lost or a slot state such as live/down/quarantined.

durationMs.description: Wall time of the step or boundary in milliseconds; omitted when zero.

detail.description: Short operator-facing context, scrubbed before storage: credential-shaped values (password, token, secret, SID, cookie, device identity) are [REDACTED].

errorClass.description: Stable failure class; never a vendor response body.

enabled.description: True when a trace ring is wired.

reason.description: Why the trace is disabled; absent when enabled.

retained.description: Entries matching the account filter in the returned window.

evicted.description: Entries overwritten by the ring since process start.

oldestSeq.description: Oldest retained sequence; omitted when the ring is empty.

nextSeq.description: Newest retained sequence, the cursor to resume from.

entries.description: Retained entries after the filters, oldest first. Never null.

reason.description: Stable machine-readable reason for catalog/connect failures (for example login_disabled, snapshot_changed, connect_cooldown).

details.description: Small non-secret context such as the current snapshotId or ineligibleReason.

useCount.description: Vendor-purchased simultaneous-connection allowance (同时连接数) from the last successful login. Absent values default to 1; values outside 1..2000 are clamped.

effectiveSlots.description: Display capacity for the account: min(useCount, AJS_ACCOUNT_SLOTS, 8, default 1). Lease admission is hard-capped at one until the multi-slot runtime exists; above 1 a lease create also returns the multi_session_unimplemented warning because only one FV session per account can be served.

trafficBudgetBytes.description: Monthly gate-enforced traffic budget in bytes. Null means unlimited; zero refuses every byte.

password.description: Validated then discarded by the skeleton; never returned.

trafficBudgetBytes.description: Monthly traffic budget in bytes. Null clears the budget (unlimited); an absent field leaves it unchanged.

AccountPatch.description: Partial update; every field is optional.

serverId.description: Vendor server this node was opened for; absent for seeded skeleton nodes.

idempotencyKey.description: The create request's retry key; empty when none was sent.

accountId.description: Optional account pin. It must be active and match platform.

ttlSeconds.description: Lease lifetime. 0 or absent uses the user's sticky TTL, then the panel lease TTL.

idempotencyKey.description: Body form of the Idempotency-Key header; the two must agree when both are sent.

warning.description: Set to multi_session_unimplemented when display capacity effectiveSlots > 1 (only one FV session per account can actually be served). A publication failure is never a warning: the create is rolled back and answered 409/503 with reason lease_publish_failed.

replayed.description: True when an Idempotency-Key matched an existing lease.

confirm.description: Must be true; a false or absent flag is refused.

UserPatch.description: Partial user update; quotaBytesMonth is a tri-state field (absent, null, integer).

lastUsedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

revokedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

secret.description: Returned exactly once; never persisted in plaintext.

meta.description: Credential-free key/value block written by the catalog.

telemetryAvailable.description: False when no real traffic meter is wired; series/totals are then empty/zero.

epayEnabled.description: True only when the 易支付 adapter is configured and serving checkout. Derived from the live adapter, never stored.

epayMode.description: Settlement shape reported by the adapter ("webhook"); absent while epay is disabled.

epayEnabled.description: Read-only. Ignored on write so a client can PATCH back the object it read.

epayMode.description: Read-only. Ignored on write so a client can PATCH back the object it read.

SettingsPatch.description: Partial settings update. Unknown fields are rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT; the read-only epay fields are accepted and ignored.

LabDisabled.description: 200 body of a list endpoint whose dependency is absent; enabled is false.

state.description: Node state, or empty when unknown.

probes.description: Connections that closed before sending a handshake byte: a health sampler dial-and-close. A probe is not a rejection.

userId.description: Panel user the gate authenticated; absent for an anonymous or loopback flow.

userName.description: Display name of the authenticated panel user; absent when unknown.

status.description: Gate vocabulary, not an HTTP status.

lastFlowAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

match.description: Null until both claimed and verified exist.

checkedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

nodeId.description: Node id derived from account+server; may be empty when no node exists.

nodeState.description: Node state, or empty when no node exists.

selected.description: P0: a node exists for this server, not the operator target.

ServersView.description: One page of the filtered catalog. total and regions count every row matching the filters.

reason.description: Stable reason such as DEVICE_POOL_DISABLED when enabled is false.

counts.description: Whole-pool counts by state, independent of the page.

hashes.description: sha256:<16 hex> for uid, osdid, cuid, cseid and machine. Raw values never leave the daemon.

claims.description: Public vendor claims (site, version, osp, osd, osv, lang); cseid is hashed instead.

confirm.description: Exact action token: RELEASE or PURGE.
Exact action token: RETIRE or QUARANTINE.
Optional; when supplied it must be EXPORT.

hashes.description: sha256:-prefixed prefixes of uid, osdid and cuid.

firstSeenAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

title.description: Vendor title; empty when the catalog is stale.

name.description: Stable executor boundary: validate, switch, dispatch or interrupted.

code.description: Stable failure class, for example LOGIN_REQUIRED, ACCOUNT_BUSY, UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE or OPERATION_UNKNOWN.

rollback.description: Runtime containment hint (restored or metadata_only). The current guarded switch never performs a reverse switch.

requestedBy.description: admin or key:<prefix>; never a secret.

drainSeconds.description: Advisory: the current guarded switch uses its own bounded drain grace.

rollback.description: Advisory: the guarded switch reports metadata_only containment; it never opens a second session to roll back.

ExportRequest.description: ids and filter are mutually exclusive.

password.description: Null when the source daemon had no sealed secret.

content.description: Document object for json/encrypted, JSON string for csv.

AccountImportCounts.description: created+updated+skipped+failed == total; renamed is a subset of created.

ScheduleGuard.description: Per-job guard rails; dryRun executes the plan without mutating state.

nextRunAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

lastRunAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

SchedulePatch.description: Partial schedule update; omitted fields keep their value.

nextRunAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

finishedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

Scope.description: Permission carried by a scoped API key. Reads are least-privilege: usage:read reaches GET /v1/usage, renewal:read reaches GET /v1/renewal/plans and GET /v1/renewal/accounts/{id}, health:read reaches GET /v1/health/nodes, events:read reaches GET /v1/events and GET /v1/events/stream, and accountIds/regions still narrow every account-scoped read. A key restricted by accountIds/regions is refused the global event stream. Webhook and backup routes stay admin-only; settings and schedule writes keep their own write scopes.

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

lastUsedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

revokedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

rateLimitPerMin.description: Requests per minute; 0 means unlimited. Defaults to 60.

secret.description: Returned exactly once; never persisted in plaintext.

id.description: Vendor period code: M1/M3/M12 months, H6 trial.

label.description: Human period label published by the vendor.

months.description: Whole months covered by the term; 0 for the trial.

priceCny.description: Vendor list price in CNY, not a quote.

autoRenewPriceCny.description: Auto-renew list price when the vendor publishes a variant.

fetchedAt.description: RFC 3339 instant of the last live fetch; the zero instant for a static table.

stale.description: True when the snapshot outlived its TTL or is the static fallback.

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339 expiry echoed from the account row.

daysLeft.description: Whole days to expiry, rounded away from zero; negative once past it.

renewalUrl.description: Official public purchase page; never carries an account id or credential.

buckets.description: Covers every day in the window so a chart can render a continuous series.

trafficBudgetBytes.description: Monthly gate-enforced budget in bytes; null means unlimited.

usedBytes.description: Gate-metered bytes for the current UTC month, independent of the queried window.

remainingBytes.description: Budget headroom for the current UTC month, clamped at zero; null when unlimited.

usedBytes.description: Byte total inside the queried window.

target.description: Host label only; no scheme, path, query string or port.

from.description: RFC 3339 inclusive lower bound after the daemon applies its defaults.

to.description: RFC 3339 inclusive upper bound after the daemon applies its defaults.

truncated.description: True when the row cap clipped the window; totals cover the first rows only.

rowsRetained.description: The store's request-log cap (10000). A client combines it with retentionDays to label bounded history.

retentionDays.description: UTC calendar days covered by the retained rows, counted inclusively from the oldest row through now. Zero when the store holds no request rows.

quotaEnforced.description: True when the gate enforces a monthly traffic budget for at least one account in the response. Account rows then carry trafficBudgetBytes, usedBytes and remainingBytes.

at.description: RFC 3339 instant the probe started, with nanoseconds.
RFC 3339 instant the probe started, with nanoseconds.

latencyMs.description: SOCKS5 handshake, TLS and response, end to end.

status.description: Target HTTP status; absent when no response was read.

errorClass.description: Absent when ok is true. http means the target answered outside 2xx.

EgressHealth.description: One node's HTTP egress measured through its live gate. enabled=false names the switch that turned sampling off instead of reporting a zero aggregate.

reason.description: Present when egress sampling is off.

events.description: Empty or absent subscribes to every event.

secretAvailable.description: Whether the sealed signing secret can still be opened.

url.description: https receiver; http is only allowed for loopback hosts.

events.description: Empty or absent subscribes to every event.

secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing secret, returned exactly once.

httpStatus.description: Absent when the attempt never got a response.

passphrase.description: 12-1024 bytes. Never logged and never stored.

BackupEnvelope.description: Encrypted panel backup. The payload is AES-256-GCM ciphertext over a tar that starts with manifest.json; the whole header is authenticated as additional data.

version.description: Envelope format version; this build writes 1.

createdAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the envelope was sealed at (UTC).

payload.description: Base64 AES-256-GCM ciphertext of the tar payload.

passphrase.description: Optional. Without it the response carries the header only, because the manifest lives inside the encrypted payload.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex digest of the blob.

required.description: True for state.json whenever the backup carries it.

BackupManifest.description: Blob index stored inside the encrypted payload. It names sizes and digests only; no blob content is returned.

supported.description: False when this build cannot open the envelope (a backup from a newer daemon).

dryRun.description: Defaults to true: an omitted field never writes a file.

confirm.description: Must be "RESTORE" when dryRun is false.

BackupDiff.description: Dry-run comparison of the live state directory with the backup. Byte sizes only; blob contents never leave the daemon.

restartRequired.description: True after an apply: the running daemon still holds the replaced panel and must be restarted.

exitRecommended.description: True after an apply: the restored panel is on disk, this process has stopped writing state.json snapshots (the refusal is logged once as state_save_suppressed_after_restore) and it cannot serve the restored panel. Stop it now; a graceful SIGTERM leaves the restored state.json untouched.

files.description: Blobs an apply wrote, in write order. Empty for a dry run.

warning.description: What the caller must do next: nothing was written (dry run) or the daemon must restart (apply).

TenantStatus.description: pending owns no PanelUser, lease or key; active is bound to exactly one user; suspended has its user disabled and its sessions and API keys revoked.

email.description: Canonical lowercase address; unique across tenants.

userId.description: Linked PanelUser id; null until approval.

approvedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null while pending.

suspendedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null unless suspended.

password.description: Hashed with Argon2id; the plaintext is never stored or logged.

user.description: Linked user metadata; never contains a credential.

csrfToken.description: Per-session CSRF token for X-CSRF-Token. Rotated after a daemon restart; re-read this route before mutating.

TenantKeyCreateRequest.description: An empty label selects the daemon default. A tenant may hold at most ten active keys.

TenantApproveRequest.description: Supply exactly one of userId or user. The bind, the optional user creation, activation and the audit row commit atomically.

active.description: Inactive plans are refused for new orders; existing snapshots are unaffected.
false deactivates; true reactivates. Existing orders keep their snapshot.

previousQuotaBytes.description: Quota the grant replaced; restored on revocation.

expiresAt.description: Lease expiry, paidAt + leaseTtlSeconds. Service ends here, not at a browser timer.

leaseEndedReason.description: Read-only projection: the durable machine reason the grant lease ended, set only while the paid term is unexpired and the lease is no longer serving. Absent on a live grant.

leaseEndedAt.description: Read-only projection: RFC 3339 instant the grant lease ended; empty when unknown.

revokedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null while the grant is live.

providerRef.description: Offline receipt reference or provider payment reference; null before settlement.

reviewRequired.description: True when conflicting or late evidence needs offline reconciliation. No grant is created for such a row.

paidAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null before settlement.

activatedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null until activation succeeds.

cancelledAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null unless cancelled.

refundedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null unless refunded.

grant.description: The order's one entitlement; null before activation or after quarantine.

reference.description: Offline receipt/reference; never a card number.

offlineFundsReceived.description: Explicit attestation that offline funds were received.

reference.description: Evidence of the already completed offline refund.

payUrl.description: Hosted 易支付 checkout URL. Opening it is not a payment fact; the order stays awaiting_payment until a verified notify or reconciliation settles it.
